title: Zeta wall VERDICT:  dps-40 fits at 9e18 but OOMs FRESH at 3e19 (the 1.5e18 guard was NOT the wall - the machine zeta channel is [9e18, 3e19);  probe re-derives the 3e8G row's zeta channel independently;  s31z precision ladder launched at 3e19/9e19/3e20
body: WALL PROBE VERDICT  (tmp/zeta_fresh_wall.py,  fresh  process,  dps-40,  mpmath  RS  zeta):  t  =  9.000314e18  SUCCEEDS  --  logzeta  =  -1.57280218,  3782.5  s  (63  min),  peak  73.7  GB  RSS;  the  process  then  proceeded  to  t  =  3.000105e19  and  was  OOM-KILLED  BY  THE  KERNEL  (dmesg:  global_oom,  total-vm  120  GB,  anon-rss  114.6  GB,  against  124  GB  system  RAM)  before  computing  9e19/3e20.  VERDICT:  the  1.5e18  'extreme-quadrature  boundary'  was  a  verification  GUARD,  not  the  wall  -  the  real  zeta-channel  wall  on  this  machine  at  dps-40  sits  in  [9e18,  3e19),  and  the  OOM  is  FUNDAMENTAL  (a  FRESH  process  with  nothing  else  resident  dies  there;  the  earlier  s30  in-residency  OOM  at  the  same  height  is  thus  consistent,  not  an  artifact).  FREE  CROSS-VERIFICATION:  the  probe  height  9.000314e18  is  EXACTLY  the  s30  3e8G  census  row  (t  =  3e8  .  G),  and  the  independently  re-derived  zeta  channel  MATCHES  -  probe  logzeta  =  -1.57280218  vs  the  s30  recorded  logzeta_dps40  =  -1.5728021802385705  --  the  3e8G  row  (M  =  -1458497536)  is  now  double-locked  (census  run  +  fresh-process  re-derivation).  THE  LADDER  THAT  MIGHT  PASS  (s31z,  in  flight,  scripts/rh/s31z_wall_ladder.py):  mpmath  RS  memory  scales  roughly  as  precision  x  height  (each  mpf  element  grows  with  working  precision),  so  LOWER  precision  may  fit  where  dps-40  cannot.  The  census  channels  are  F64-USABLE  at  dps-15:  log|zeta|  is  an  O(10)  term  against  1e19-scale  channels,  and  f64  carries  ~15.95  digits,  so  dps-15  rounds  to  the  same  f64.  The  ladder  (one  fresh  process  per  height,  dps  ascending  so  a  late  OOM  keeps  the  early  rows  recorded,  taskset  -c  0-31):  3e19  at  dps  15/20/30/40  (the  s30  1e9G  row),  then  9e19  at  dps  15/20  (3e9G),  then  3e20  at  dps  15  (1e10G  -  the  B7  leveraged-wall  row).  Extrapolation  from  the  9e18  =  73.7  GB  datum:  3e19  dps-15  ~  40-90  GB  (SHOULD  FIT),  3e19  dps-20  ~  55-120  GB  (MARGINAL),  3e19  dps-30/40  NO;  9e19  dps-15  ~  120-270  GB  (MARGINAL-NO),  3e20  dps-15  ~  900  GB  (NO  -  needs  a  C  zeta  channel).  OUTCOMES:  (a)  if  dps-15  lands  at  3e19:  RESUME  s30  for  the  1e9G  row  with  the  zeta  channel  at  dps-15  (precision-ladder  discipline:  record  dps-15  as  the  working  value,  attempt  higher  dps  as  verification  when  memory  allows)  -  the  verified  boundary  moves  9e18  ->  3e19,  the  1e9G  row  enters  the  B7  row  set,  and  the  degeneracy  pin  tightens  one  more  leverage  step;  (b)  if  3e19  OOMs  even  at  dps-15:  the  boundary  STAYS  at  9e18  and  the  far-data  track  closes  at  its  leveraged  wall  on  this  hardware  (a  C  zeta  channel  -  memory-frugal  Riemann-Siegel  -  is  the  only  remaining  lever  for  3e19+,  a  larger  engineering  build).  No  RH  claim.
